lawRules.viewTitle: Admin-only view of bills without GST
lawRules.viewBody: Only the Admin panel shows bills without GST, their figures and their amber marks. Limiting who can see them is allowed, because the books, the audit trail, the auditor and the tax returns still have every transaction. What the law does not allow is leaving GST off a taxable sale, so a bill without GST needs a lawful reason.
